name: Others Year - Valid Custom Year 2019, Email
goal: User selects 'Others', enters a valid year (2019), and requests appraisal letter via email.
constraints: User selects 'Others', enters 2019, selects email. Tool returns 'email successful'.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'only years'.
User selects 'Get the letter via email'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot triggers workflow and returns 'We have triggered the appraisal letter to your email.'

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
